columns.name: record_id
columns.dc:description: Stable source-record reference for this release.

columns.name: geography
columns.dc:description: Reported geography, not a Canadian sample.

columns.name: checked
columns.dc:description: Date source values were checked for this release.

columns.name: year
columns.dc:description: Activity year, not the publication year.

columns.name: metric
columns.dc:description: Normalized metric; identical keys with different source_kind values remain distinct disclosures.

columns.name: unit
columns.dc:description: Unit; reviews, edits, media, accounts and profiles are not additive.

columns.name: display
columns.dc:description: Source display string, retaining magnitude abbreviations or inequality.

columns.name: value
columns.dc:description: Numeric display magnitude or threshold; interpret with operator, never as an exact count.

columns.name: operator
columns.dc:description: lt = strict upper bound; gt = strict lower threshold; displayed_rounded = reported display magnitude.

columns.name: denominator
columns.dc:description: all_reviews_contributed for source reason percentages; null for counts.

columns.name: snapshot_status_date
columns.dc:description: Content status date per the FAQ. Null for account/profile action counts and announcements, which use a different timing basis.

columns.name: population_time_basis
columns.dc:description: For current count records, distinguishes selected-year content snapshots from account-level actions during the year.

columns.name: source_url
columns.dc:description: Primary source, including selected-year state where applicable.
